rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Chunk 0: "the commit your un-packaged run started at" and chunk 3: "the starting-point SHA Claude reported before the send-off" resolve under the session-artifact carve-out (student's own prior send-off run). Chunk 1's "the six sub-steps" resolves in-chunk against the fenced {{prompt:ae101-m5-worktree-setup}} block sitting directly below it. Chunk 2's "the output"/"the two paths Claude checked" resolve against chunk 1's prompt run and CLAUDE.local.md/observations/ naming. No never-named or vague-with-history referents found.
No chunk points at another file by position; all backward references are within-file or session-artifact-scoped.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Every backward reference points at a beat that exists.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Chunk 3's "before the send-off" and chunk 0's "your un-packaged run" point at the student's own prior M4 send-off, which the module's own sequencing (this exercise's placement) guarantees already happened; no dead beat reference found.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No guess-before-reveal instruction anywhere in this file.
Every chunk (title metadata, Phase 1 prompt beat, copy-check, coordinate-recovery ladder) carries a self-standing claim.

"Phase 1: Fork it" → forking content; "Check the copy landed" → the copy-verification bullets; "Anchor the fork to the run coordinates" → the coordinates-recovery ladder (maintainer note confirms this heading was deliberately kept neutral because the first bullet is the normal path, not just the failure case). All headers match their chunk's content.

No "Not X. Not Y. Z." construction, no anaphora/epistrophe triples, no self-grading superlatives, no unlabeled-number-with-retraction, no abstraction-noun stacks, no verb triplets with an empty leg, in any chunk.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Internal dialect never lands on a slide.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Vocabulary used (worktree, split test, gitignored, send-off, m4/<slug> branch, Run coordinates block) is training-established or ordinary engineering shop talk for AE101's IC audience, not repo-internal dialect (compendium, beat, forcing function, surface-as-noun). The prompt body itself is fenced and exempt.
